manufacturer_data.description: Victron Energy (0x02E1); Instant Readout payloads begin with record type 0x10.

methods.notes: Passive scan: match company id 0x02E1 and a leading 0x10 record byte, then AES-CTR-decrypt the record with the device key. No connection.

manufacturer_data.description: Victron Energy. Instant Readout advertisements carry record type 0x10 as the first payload byte. The victron-ble decoder filters on company id 0x02E1; the record body is AES-CTR encrypted with the per-device key.

device.name: Victron Energy Instant Readout (BLE broadcast)
device.notes:
Victron's "Instant Readout" is a read-only BLE telemetry broadcast that most modern Victron products emit — SmartSolar MPPT chargers, BMV/SmartShunt battery monitors, Phoenix inverters, Orion DC/DC, SmartLithium batteries, Lynx BMS, Multi RS, VE.Bus and DC energy meters. Unusually, Victron itself PUBLISHED the advertisement format. There is no connection and no cloud: a scanner reads the manufacturer-data advertisement and decrypts it with the per-device 128-bit key the owner extracts once from the VictronConnect app.
ADVERTISEMENT: BLE manufacturer data, company id 0x02E1 (737). The Instant Readout container (byte offsets after the company id, per keshavdv/victron-ble) is: bytes 0-1 a fixed prefix (manufacturer record type 0x10); bytes 2-3 the model id (u16 LE); byte 4 the record/readout type (see RECORD TYPES); bytes 5-6 the AES-CTR IV/nonce (u16 LE); byte 7 the first byte of the encryption key (a key-check byte, so a receiver can detect a stale key); bytes 8+ the AES-CTR ciphertext. Encryption: AES-CTR, 128-bit key; the nonce is the 2-byte IV at bytes 5-6; the CTR counter is MSB and starts at 0; all current records fit one AES block (<= 20 bytes on nRF devices). Changing the Bluetooth PIN rotates the key.
RECORD TYPES (the byte-4 readout type, NOT byte 0): 0x01 Solar Charger, 0x02 Battery Monitor, 0x03 Inverter, 0x04 DC/DC, 0x05 SmartLithium, 0x06 Inverter RS, 0x08 AC Charger, 0x09 Smart Battery Protect, 0x0A Lynx BMS, 0x0B Multi RS, 0x0C VE.Bus, 0x0D DC Energy Meter. Records may be extended but never re-ordered; parsers must length-check every field and treat all-ones values as NA.
NOTE: the telemetry is entirely in the advertisement — no GATT connection is used. The `services` block below lists only the standard BLE Generic Access present on the device; the real content is in payload_formats.

openness.notes: Victron published the advertisement format on its wiki/community forum; nothing here was reverse-engineered. keshavdv/victron-ble is the reference decoder. The per-device key must still be read out of the VictronConnect app (device settings -> Product Info).

pairing.notes: The Instant Readout path never connects: a scanner reads the advertisement and decrypts it. The one-time pairing in VictronConnect that the owner does to read out the per-device key is an app-side step on their own hardware, not a wire requirement on the reader — and it is worth distinguishing, because a client that waits to bond before decoding broadcasts will wait forever. Changing the unit's Bluetooth PIN rotates the key, which is the one way that app-side pairing state reaches this path.

issued_to_client: The advertisement key (read once from VictronConnect)
credentials.notes: The advertisement is encrypted with a per-device key; anyone in range with the key can read the telemetry. No control is possible over this surface — it is read-only.
stored_on_device: Per-device AES-CTR advertisement key (rotated on Bluetooth PIN change)

factory_reset.description: The reset is driven from VictronConnect rather than from a button, and the second step is the one people miss: the unit has to lose power within ten seconds of the command or the reset does not take. Vendor troubleshooting reaches for this after a firmware update fails to clear a fault, so it tends to be run by someone already frustrated and skipping steps.
factory_reset.effect: Returns the product's own configuration to defaults; on a solar charger that means it re-runs automatic voltage detection at the next power-up. It is not an advertisement-level operation — but changing the unit's Bluetooth PIN, which is a separate action, rotates the encryption key and invalidates any Instant Readout key already extracted.

procedures.basis: Victron's SmartSolar MPPT 75/10 to 100/20 manual, which gives this sequence in its troubleshooting section.
procedures.name: Reset to defaults from VictronConnect, then remove power

steps.action: Open the product's settings page in VictronConnect.
Open the menu behind the three vertical dots in the upper right and choose "Reset to defaults".
Un-power the unit within ten seconds.
steps.expect: At the next power-up the charger performs its initial automatic voltage detection.

methods.description: Passive: scan for company id 0x02E1, AES-CTR-decrypt the record with the per-device key. The key is a one-time extraction from VictronConnect, not a wire step.

steps.action: In VictronConnect, open the device's Product Info and copy the Instant Readout advertisement key.
Scan for company id 0x02E1 and decrypt the record with that key.
steps.expect: Fields decode per payload_formats for the record type.

setup.notes: Nothing to provision on the wire: pair/bond in VictronConnect once and read the per-device advertisement key out of the app (Product Info -> Instant Readout details). After that any scanner decodes the broadcasts. Changing the Bluetooth PIN rotates the key.

rejoin.notes: No network membership. Reading is passive; a PIN change requires re-extracting the key.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The record header, AES-CTR scheme, record-type table and Solar Charger / Battery Monitor field layouts are from Victron's own published spec and keshavdv/victron-ble.

battery_monitor_0x02.description: Record type 0x02 (BMV / SmartShunt). Decrypted body, little-endian; NA sentinels as above.

fields.description: 16-bit aux field (aux voltage / mid-voltage / temperature, selected by a 2-bit aux-input selector).
fields.name: aux_input

solar_charger_0x01.description: Record type 0x01 (SmartSolar MPPT). Decrypted body, little-endian; all-ones values are NA sentinels (0xFF / 0x7FFF / 0xFFFF / 0x1FF).

services.name: Generic Access (standard)
services.notes: Standard BLE Generic Access, listed only to record a connectable surface. Instant Readout telemetry does NOT use GATT — it is entirely in the manufacturer advertisement decoded in payload_formats below. VictronConnect itself uses a separate vendor GATT not documented here.
